newsitem.title: UK: Racal shares fall on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Racal shares fall on profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Racal Electronics fell sharply in pre-market trade on Monday after the company warned that half year results on Tuesday would be substantially less than current market expectations.
The shares were indicated down 37-1/2p at 237-1/2p by 0806 GMT.
Racal said on Monday it expects first half profits in the region of 21 million stg, almost 20 million below analysts expectations.
The company blames lower orders in its Radio Group division for most of the decline.
Full-year profits were expected to reach around 50 million stg after exceptional charges of 20 million stg. Analysts had been forecasting profits of between 65-94 million stg.
